summary: Search-first domain verification found that the recorded official_domain texashealthhuguley.org is wrong for all three CCNs. Each facility's true operator publishes a valid first-party cms-hpt.txt pointer and a facility-specific CMS v3.0.0-template standard-charges CSV whose declared location name, address, state and attestation match the CMS identity record. Complete files were downloaded and hashed.

domain_searches.query: "Memorial Hospital" Gonzales Texas hospital official website price transparency
domain_searches.basis: https://www.gonzaleshealthcare.com homepage shows Gonzales Healthcare Systems, Gonzales, Texas 78629; /services/memorial-hospital page names Memorial Hospital; recorded Huguley domain is a different Burleson hospital

domain_searches.query: "Memorial Hospital" Seminole Texas hospital official website price transparency standard charges
domain_searches.basis: https://seminolehospitaldistrict.com homepage shows Seminole Hospital District, 209 NW 8th St, Seminole, TX; payerprice lists Memorial Hospital-Seminole CCN 451358 at this district

domain_searches.query: "Memorial Hospital" Dumas Texas Moore County hospital official website price transparency
domain_searches.basis: https://mchd.net homepage shows Moore County Hospital District, Dumas, TX 79029; Memorial Home Health & Hospice pages confirm the Memorial naming under MCHD

method: Z.ai web search (domain discovery), curl/Invoke-WebRequest GETs, complete-file downloads hashed with SHA-256; CMS identity from data/hpt-audit/nationwide-reconciliation.json facility records
changed_versus_prior: Prior proofs (2026-09-22 browser rechecks) recorded only the wrong Huguley domain with pointer 'Permission denied'. New: correct first-party operator domains identified; valid pointer files retrieved and hashed on each; facility-specific CMS v3.0.0 MRFs retrieved in full, hashed, with declared identity, TX state, dates, versions and TRUE attestations matching the CMS records.
not_established: Nothing about the Huguley facility itself (that is a different hospital, Burleson TX); parser-level validation of every row was not performed beyond header/metadata structure inspection.
next_action: Retain the pointer-to-file chains; recheck on next publisher pointer or file change.
